description: Make purchases real and enforce campaign allowance. Add a NEW migration widening the orders.plan CHECK to include 'single' and adding billing_type/period_start/credit_consumed; add a service-role Supabase client (orders has only a SELECT RLS policy, so writes need service role); add an entitlements library; verify Stripe payment server-side on the success page and idempotently UPSERT an orders row; enforce allowance in launchCampaign; surface entitlement state on the Billing and campaign-create pages. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Create NEW migration supabase/migrations/20261101_orders_entitlements.sql (do NOT edit existing migrations). DDL: drop+recreate the orders plan CHECK to include 'single' (alter table public.orders drop constraint if exists orders_plan_check, add constraint orders_plan_check check (plan in ('single','starter','growth','enterprise'))); add column if not exists billing_type text; add column if not exists period_start timestamptz; add column if not exists credit_consumed boolean not null default false; backfill update: set billing_type = case when plan='single' then 'one-time' else 'monthly' end where billing_type is null; create index if not exists on orders(user_id, status). Add a top comment: 'Run this in the Supabase SQL editor before testing (the app cannot run DDL).'

Inspect src/lib/supabase/ for an existing service-role/admin client. If none exists, create src/lib/supabase/admin.ts exporting createAdminClient() built from @supabase/supabase-js createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } }); if SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing, return null so callers degrade to 'no verified orders' instead of crashing.

Create src/lib/entitlements.ts: export PLAN_QUOTA (single:1, starter:2, growth:10, enterprise:Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY); export async getEntitlement(userId): read paid orders via the service-role client and count campaigns for the user with created_at >= start of current UTC calendar month; compute monthlyQuota (from the active monthly order's plan), usedThisMonth, remainingMonthly, oneTimeCredits (paid single orders minus those with credit_consumed=true), canCreate (remainingMonthly>0 OR oneTimeCredits>0); return a safe no-plan result (canCreate:false, plan:null) when there is no service-role client or no paid orders. Export async consumeAllowance(userId): if remainingMonthly>0 do nothing (monthly covers it); else mark the oldest paid single order with credit_consumed=false as credit_consumed=true.

Rewrite src/app/dashboard/services/success/page.tsx as an async server component: read searchParams.session_id; if present AND process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set, GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <key>; require (payment_status==='paid' || status==='complete') AND session.metadata.user_id === current user's id; then UPSERT orders via the service-role client with onConflict 'stripe_session_id' { user_id, plan: metadata.plan, billing_type: plan==='single'?'one-time':'monthly', amount_cents: session.amount_total, currency: session.currency||'eur', status:'paid', stripe_session_id: id, period_start: monthly? start-of-month : null }. On ANY failure (no key, unpaid, mismatch, fetch error) do NOT grant and render a graceful message (keep existing success visual + CTA). Keep the existing CheckCircle2 layout; add a short entitlement summary via getEntitlement.

Edit src/app/dashboard/campaigns/actions.ts launchCampaign: after auth, before the campaigns insert, call getEntitlement(user.id); if !canCreate throw new Error("You've used all campaigns included in your plan this month. Upgrade or buy a single campaign to continue."). After a successful insert (before redirect) call consumeAllowance(user.id). Do NOT modify approveCampaign/rejectCampaign/deleteCampaign. Keep the redirect to /dashboard/campaigns/{id}.

Edit src/app/dashboard/services/page.tsx (Billing): fetch getEntitlement for the current user and render a banner showing current plan + remaining monthly campaigns + one-time credits, or 'No active plan — purchase to create campaigns.' Keep the plans grid and PurchaseButton unchanged.

Edit src/app/dashboard/campaigns/create/page.tsx: fetch getEntitlement; if !canCreate replace the form with an empty-state panel (reuse existing panel/empty-state classes) linking to /dashboard/services ('Purchase a plan to create campaigns'); else render the existing form with a small 'N campaigns remaining this month' note. Do not change form field names (title, templateId, groupId, landingPageUrl) or the action binding.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` exits 0 and `npm run build` succeeds with no type errors.
supabase/migrations/20261101_orders_entitlements.sql exists, is valid Postgres DDL, does not modify any existing migration file, and includes the 'run in Supabase SQL editor' comment.
The checkout route request shape in src/app/api/checkout/route.ts is unchanged.
launchCampaign throws the exact user-facing allowance error and inserts no campaign row when getEntitlement returns canCreate:false.
The success page does not crash when visited without session_id or when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are absent, and never grants an order on verification failure.
Order UPSERT is idempotent on stripe_session_id (refreshing the success page does not create duplicates or double-grant).
verification: Manually re-read launchCampaign and success/page.tsx to confirm: enforcement precedes insert; success page returns a graceful branch for every failure path; writes go through the service-role client.
findings: New migration filename: supabase/migrations/20261101_orders_entitlements.sql (user must run it manually in the Supabase SQL editor — adds 'single' to orders_plan_check and columns billing_type/period_start/credit_consumed, backfills billing_type, adds orders(user_id,status) index). A service-role client ALREADY existed at src/lib/supabase/admin.ts (createAdminClient); it previously could not degrade, so I modified it to return null when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing. Added null guards to its two existing callers (src/app/dashboard/users/actions.ts throws 'Service role key is not configured'; src/app/dashboard/users/page.tsx redirects to /dashboard). Entitlements API at src/lib/entitlements.ts: exports PLAN_QUOTA {single:1,starter:2,growth:10,enterprise:Infinity}, type Entitlement {canCreate,plan,monthlyQuota,usedThisMonth,remainingMonthly,oneTimeCredits}, async getEntitlement(userId) and async consumeAllowance(userId). getEntitlement returns a NO_PLAN result when no admin client or no paid orders. Active monthly plan = highest-tier paid monthly order. consumeAllowance is a no-op when remainingMonthly>0, else marks the oldest unused paid single order credit_consumed=true. Success page (src/app/dashboard/services/success/page.tsx) is now an async server component reading searchParams.session_id, verifying via Stripe GET, UPSERT onConflict 'stripe_session_id' through the admin client, graceful on all failure paths, and shows an entitlement summary. launchCampaign enforces canCreate before insert and calls consumeAllowance after insert before redirect. Billing page and campaign-create page show entitlement state. lint exits 0 and build succeeds.
